You’re not dreaming. I’ve stopped time to take the Sphere back to the shadows. Its presence here was a mistake—caused by the instability of the Gates of Shadows.
Change is imminent, human. For now, sleep. When you wake, no one will remember your feat. It must be this way. One day, you will understand...
Your acting is not convincing! I don’t believe you! Try again, please.
You call that acting? It was amateur, at best! Next time I expect much more from you.
Perhaps I should have given you a walk-on part instead. Never mind though, a good director can turn any ham into a real actor!
What’s the matter? Is this part above your skills? Come on, you should brace yourself. Try again!
I suppose it could have been worse. You could have stumbled and broken your leg when you heard the prompt-bell.
Hey, cheer up, my talented friend—tickets can be purchased for gems!
Stop! Feel the inner drama of your character: alone against injustice and ancient evil, surrounded by a mad mob... One more time!
Now for the rehearsal! The first story is as old as time itself. Maybe you’ve heard it before. So no need for costumes, just pure acting!
There was a kind monk who protected travelers from the darkness of the forest, for which he was loved. But a jealous monarch couldn’t stand it...
He sent assassins to kill the old man—and awakened the hungry forest! And now the possessed bandits begin their deadly dance for the next victim....
This is justice! The villains are fleeing! The hero sits tiredly on the ground and listens... The forest is asleep again. The curtain falls!
Live as you play, my friend! With sense and courage! I see I chose the right man. I’ll be glad to see you on this stage again.
What can I say? You’re simply... wonderful! Please, do not neglect us. Come again, more and more.
Theatre—that’s what you were born for, my friend! I want to see you on the stage as often as I can. Please come to me again!
It would have been a sin to bury such a talent as yours! You truly belong here, with us, on the stage. Please come again, we shall be waiting!
Your talent is worthy of all the world’s gold! But... the stage itself is the best award. Though I still have some prizes for you, too. So please come again!
Oh yes, what we have seen was a true drama! Bravo! You are the brightest of my stars! And the show must go on. The stage is waiting for you!

I’m no villain. I’ve given these children a gift. The gift of strength, violence! You’ll see. They’ll be the top of the food chain because of my teachings!
There is no going back now. Our path leads us across the sea. We must find a boat.

I know that as soon as the Prince draws his last breath, Shogun won’t let me live. I’m just a tool—expendable. So... I shall help you.

Go to the port. Shogun is waiting for a ship to arrive—the one bringing the Sphere. It’s the Prince’s last chance to reclaim his throne.
Nobody dares to doubt my authority! The family never forgives that. You’re not leaving alive!

Whom shall I worship in this last hour of mine? O Creator, why hast thou forsaken me? Thou gavest me power to lead them, but I have failed thee... again.

In a way, it’s a shame we dealt with him so easily. I wish I could see what a mushroom Armageddon looks like.
Begone! And revel in the last minutes of your fragile lives!
All your life is only an illusion. And we are its creators. We shall drive you mad while others count upon brute force. Fire, water, diseases—hah!
Where are you, brother? I can’t hear your voice anymore! Truly, being locked all alone is worse than fire or blade... Go, stupid ones. The Father is waiting.
‘We’? Shadow, it seems like our foe is off his head. Excuse me, which of your personalities are we talking with? Perhaps your ‘brother’ could be more rational?
Laughing at us, human? My brother suggests your souls to be sent to the abyss of eternal misery... Then your world shall yield, without a single drop of blood.
I would’ve killed you, for my mercy is truly boundless. But my brother is less tolerant; you’re free to go, in case if you don’t lose your wits on the way out.
At last, this magnificent magic is in your reach! How about scorching something right away?
This mine is a sacred place. Why are you here? Leave and meet your destiny with honour. The last thing you will hear is the earth trembling beneath your feet.
Damnation! Shall I have to wait for thousands of years again? I’ve moved continents! Cleansing the earth was my role!
My great-grandfather told me of the Eternals fighting for the right to hurl their retribution upon mankind. We are now in the middle of their war.
I’ve treated humans kindly, a rare trait among the Eternals. I helped your species many times. So run and say your last goodbyes to your dear ones!

Are you trying to correct your mistake? You opened the Gates, but only the Eternals can eliminate the Shadow contagion. Not being one of us, you are weak.
You shall die, like all the rest. Magma flows through my veins, and it will cover all the land, cleansing it for new life.
What cellar is this, and what are we doing here?
This is the antechamber of the Eternals’ domain. Their slumber lasted for millennia, but the Gates of Shadows have put the world in peril. They’ve awakened.
Cool—that means they’ll help us deal with the Gates quick and easy!
Oh, no. They shall destroy the Gates, but they shall also destroy the whole of mankind. For them, it’s only another cycle of destruction and creation.

Enough! I concede. But know this: you have roused my brother. Be not deceived by his appearance, for he is quick and deadly!
I saw some half-ruined dwellings and a huge statue. Are there humans living here?
Only fanatics. They worship the Eternals in hope to be spared. Truly, they are blind in their faith. If we fail, they will soon learn the truth.
I have been telling my brethren that it is my duty to decide the planet’s destiny. Watch, unbelievers, as my blaze blankets the land!
Dark waters will engulf the earth and the Gates of Shadows! Their secret will be lost in the abyss. And there will be no one left on the surface to tell it!
For the first time in a thousand years a human wins. Your will to live is so strong! But whatever you do, the end shall be the same: you will die.
I pray you tell us, o most ancient one, does not mankind have a chance to atone for its sins against you?
Your fate is already decided, you only choose the way in which your lives shall end. But the decision belongs not to me, but to the one who knows no mercy.
We have been dealing with humans for so long that we’ve learned to understand you. But the one who rules us had no such desire. You will soon know that.
For thousands of years I’ve watched the withering of your kind. There is some beauty in it. I think I shall keep you alive—just for fun.

Please have mercy! Butcher doesn’t know about our relationship. He thinks love makes you weak. Please don’t tell him about us!
Your fight with Hermit destroyed my business! Now everyone knows the secret.
I’ll have to think of a new plan... I’ll have plenty of time for that. A ship awaits me. Farewell.
No; you’ve hurt Bird! You will pay for what you’ve done to my love!
I don’t understand. Why didn’t anyone come to my aid? Could it be that Butcher... used me? No. No, I refuse to believe it!
Butcher is our leader, our guiding star. Even more, he raised me from a little boy. I owe him everything. We all do!
It used to be all about having fun, breaking rules, being young. But things have changed so much. This... cult... is too serious. It’s not fun anymore.
Hermit warned us about Butcher’s gang, but this... this is much worse. He has been misleading children, turning them, building his own private army!
That’s disgusting! How could he do such a thing? Give me your sword and I’ll kill him myself!
You’ve met Bull, that worthless fool? It was Butcher himself that killed his parents. I always thought it was a mistake letting that little brat live.
What’s that? Another shadow? I wonder, do shadows bleed...
My defeat means nothing. This island will be your grave. Butcher will take your life away.
I hear the gentle whisper of your blood speaking to me. Come, and I will free it from that confining cocoon.
A mysterious red seal won from Butcher in deadly combat. One of the six parts of the key to the Gates of Shadows.
Hermit told us that the Prince’s warlord, Shogun, betrayed his lord and paid a certain Butcher to kidnap him. It was time to visit the bandit.
Have you heard anything about the place we are heading? Who is in charge?
Of course, I’ve heard! Some time ago the Pirate King disappeared. His daughter, Wasp, took over and now controls this harbor.
It’s said Wasp has a magic amulet which brings luck to its owner...
An amulet, you say? That sounds familiar. I wonder if that’s the item we’ve been searching for...
Getting to Wasp won’t be easy. She’s had some trouble recently and has gone into hiding. Anyway, not my problem. A job awaits! Good luck!
So, you’re a tough one, eh? Let’s see how far you get...
Ah, so you’ve met these ‘New Blood’ fellas. Some of Wasp’s crewmen mutinied and took over her ships.
She’s got a few loyal henchmen by her side, but they’re still in hiding... oh, I should be going!
I saw you deal with that mutineer bilge rat Kraken. You know, Wasp could use a warrior like you.
Deal with the rest of those New Blood fools and the captain will make you rich!
Kraken has lost and his ship is under my command now. Great team we are, right?
But Wasp has other men, you know. Off you go!
Who the hell are you? This port is closed. But... You’ve got a nice ship there—I claim it in the name of New Blood!
You’ve chosen the wrong side, lad. When Wasp is through with you, you’ll disappear just like her father! Mark my words!
The Pirate King disappears without a trace, Wasp takes over, and nobody asks where her father went!
She had something to do with it, I tell ya. I don’t trust that wench, and neither should you!
Your strength belongs with New Blood! The Pirate King disappeared because of his ungrateful daughter—and you’re helping spread her lies!
Wasp’s old dogs sent you, eh? They put their money on the wrong guy. I’ll hoist you over the yardarm, and you’ll sink like all the rest!
We stand to lose this war because of the likes of you. Brothers killing brothers, and you profit from their suffering. You won’t leave this city alive!
So slow you are. I expected you to be finished by now. Be quick, I didn’t hire you to just stand here!
Take over Skipper’s frigate and defeat Wasp. You’ll get no payment before that.
So, you’ve dealt with the mutineers and have come for your reward?
Wasp was going to give you an audience until she saw you with that petty profiteer Sly! He’s been selling weapons to New Blood!
Sly! Is this true? Have you armed their enemies?
I can explain everything! But now isn’t the time... can you help a friend out here?
If only the Pirate King were here—none of this would be happening! Damn that girl and her selfish acts!
What’s that silly girl gotten herself into now? If it weren’t for me, Wasp would be long dead. You’re just another mess for me to clean up!
A mysterious purple seal won from Wasp in a deadly combat. One of the six parts of the key to the Gates of Shadows.
The Prince’s troubles were caused by a woman! She devised a plan to overthrow him by using a magical Sphere—which was now being brought to the nearby port...
Many apologies, but I happened to hear you speaking with Wasp. I understand there is certain object you wish to obtain.
Let’s say, there is a friend of mine who knows something of this object’s whereabouts.
I dare suggest he would happily give this object away to a person able to clear this harbor of Wasp’s vile crew.
Defeat Wasp’s men—and I’ll give the seal to you.
I should thank you, honestly. Before you came, I had two problems: the mutineers and my so-called ‘advisors’ trying to restrict my control.
But now, thanks to you, I’m the only one in power here!
You are here already? There are rumors of your journey, you know. But if you expect to fight me—I’m going to disappoint you.
Unfortunately, I no longer possess the seal you are looking for. It’s been stolen from me several months ago, and I’ve heard nothing of it ever since then.
That’s it? That’s all you’ve got? Weak! Get up and fight me for real... if you can!
Well, what do we have here? An interesting specimen... I’ve met so many men, so boring, so average.
But... There’s something peculiar about this one. I’ll keep my eye on you.
An interesting specimen? She’s so full of herself! Shadow is above flattery.
She must be the woman Wasp spoke of. Something is... bothering me, but I am not sure what.
She doesn’t scare me... but all these bodies do. My God, it’s a slaughterhouse! And look at the damage from the siege engines!
I came as a marauder, but something changed. There’s a light in my heart for Widow. But I failed. I... I am not worthy of her affection.
I can’t forget that beautiful woman! Her face is all I see when I close my eyes.
I spent all my money on a gift for her—surely, these precious gems will tell her how I feel about her.
You did what? Are you feeling all right?
Am I all... No! No, I’m not all right! What’s happening to me? This is maddening!
I’ve long forgotten what it’s like to fail in combat. You are clearly different from all those peasant fools. Who do you think has caused all this mayhem? Us? Ha!
We aren’t savages. Unlike those simpletons raging furiously at each other in futile hope that Widow’s grace will fall upon them.
Widow is my goddess! I would give all the riches in the world just to see her smile at me.
I saw the way you were looking at her... her face will be the last thing you ever see!
She came from nowhere as we hunted. We were dumbstruck. When I finally came to my senses, blood stained my hands, and my brothers were no more...
All these men are vying for Widow’s affection. But they’re not thinking straight—they’ve been charmed. That’s why they’re attacking!
Sly’s gone mad, too. But, Sensei, why doesn’t it affect you?
I feel her pull, too, but I am skilled enough to resist the power.
I’m the last of my tribe. The spirits showed me the way to the most miraculous woman I’ve ever seen.
I sacrificed much to attract her attention; I can’t allow you to steal her from me now!
Am I cursed? Love has driven me to madness and brought me to my knees, turning me into a mindless youth.
But my body can’t keep up with my ambitions. I’m just a lonely, pathetic, old man.
Maybe I’m not as young or strong as I used to be, but my experience will win over your arrogance! The woman will be mine.
She has a strange power over men, beyond her beauty—it’s magic! I can’t resist, but I see her true nature.
She is cruel and evil. I’m begging you: free me from this misery!
Hello again! I’ve decided to repay you for your services back in the harbor. After all, I owe you one.
Besides, surprisingly, not all citizens were quite happy about my empowerment. I’m afraid they’ve even become a little angered by it.
So I figured that I could use some kind of protection. Against the angry mob, you know. You won’t mind, do you?
You’ll go no farther. Widow has chosen me as her favored watchdog, and I am to stop anyone from coming to see her. Prepare to feel my fists!
You’re a perfect representative of your kind—vain and self-satisfied!
Widow will punish you and turn you into her favourite little toy. Mark my words!
I don’t need some magic spell to love Widow. Her power over men excites me.
Love is the perfect way to rob you men of your free will. But somehow you’re beyond her control... so I’ll fix it!
A mysterious orange seal won from Widow in a deadly fight. One of the six parts of the key to the Gates of Shadows.
The pirate girl told me about Widow’s complicated history with the Prince. I didn’t get the Sphere, but I learned that the Prince went to the mountains to find Widow.
Such a powerful young man—you’ll be a perfect addition to my collection.
Fight my magic all you want; I like the struggle. No matter, I’ll win, and you’ll stay by my side forever!
I’ll be here when you’re ready to try again. A worthy adversary such as yourself... we could be good friends. Or perhaps more?
It will be full of trickery and illusion. Take care, my disciple, and be ready for anything.
You... The Prince! But... But, you should be dead! It’s impossible! Troops, fall back!
Interesting... This fool seems to think you are some ‘prince.’ I think you should play along.
You, there—halt! If you drop your weapons and come out where I can see, I promise you a swift and painless death.
Mercy, o Prince! I will leave this city; I’ll never take up a weapon again, only spare my worthless life. Please, my lord!
A Prince, huh? Have you been keeping secrets from us?
No, this is obviously a case of mistaken identity. But, if they fear him, it is all the better.
Look, Captain! There he is, just as I said! The Prince has returned from the grave!
Coward! I should have hanged you long ago. Step aside, so that I may deal with this beggar and prove he is no Prince.
Forgive me for doubting you, my Prince. I fear Shogun’s lies have entangled my mind.
After your disappearance, Shogun claimed you were killed by traitors. He executed these so-called conspirators without a trial, then seized power. But that was only the beginning...
You’re a threat to Shogun’s power. He will stop at nothing to destroy you if he finds out you’re alive. Please, my Prince, leave this city before it’s too late!
So, you are the impostor who pretends to be my master! Your deceit insults his memory. For that, you will pay!
My defeat will do you no good, monster. Shogun knows you are here. Whatever you are planning, he will stop you...
You should have never returned, Prince. Did you think your former subjects would submit to you after what you did?
Your highborn head has no place here, except on the end of a pike!
I know you have no mercy for the defeated, Prince.
But whatever torture you’ve prepared, it will not compare to the fate awaiting those who fail to carry out Shogun’s will.
A mysterious jade seal won from Shogun in a deadly fight. One of the six parts of the key to the Gates of Shadows.
The magical Sphere drove the Prince mad! It gave him immense power... power that threatened to destroy us all! I couldn’t allow that to happen.
No... This is impossible... I am invincible! I cannot lose, not now! And you... you think you can take my empire away from me? Hah!
They used your name to scare children, yes. But I brought them order; I gave them the Empire! My people won’t follow a petty prince now...
Well done, my disciple. You now have all six Seals needed to close the Gates. But don’t celebrate just yet. First, we must reach the Gates...
So... Here you are, after all of these years. What took you so long? Have you found another realm to ruin with your greed and incompetence?
I see my assassins haven’t failed completely. You’re only a shadow of the Prince I knew.
Did you really think you could match my power? I have conquered countless lands! Enslaved whole nations! Even Kings bow before me!
How strange... We’ve travelled so many days, and yet there are no signs of life. No people, no animals, no trees... Nothing but a huge wasteland.
Look! That glow in the distance—it’s the Ivory City! It’s burning! How can that be? It’s supposed to be full of people! Can we still help them?
This land is close to the Gates of Shadows and has suffered greatly. I remember fertile plains once surrounded the great Ivory City...
Perhaps, but we must be careful. No natural fire can burn so long; this realm belongs to the shadows now.
Weapons down. Come with me. Titan awaits your arrival.
Well, he’s switched off. Let me check his memory chip. And... Done! The ancient one is in the Stone Grove. It’s a real tomb, but we have no choice. Let’s go!
How dare you approach the voice of the ancients? Their ghosts scream in anger over Titan’s foul touch upon their once beautiful land! Show your true face, beast!
You’re strong, capable. But Titan is no simple brute. He can harrow your mind, leaving no chance to defend. His will turns into your will. But there’s a way.
Before Titan came, an ancient tribe lived here. Their wills were strong. He was unable to turn them into his mindless soldiers, so he ordered their destruction.
But one of these ancients escaped and hid... somewhere. I tried to use Cronos, my greatest creation, to find him.
Oh, I remember that one. He returned insane, and then just ran away again. That was a real mess...
The ancient one is powerful. He wiped Cronos’ memory, replacing it with an idea to cleanse this world of all vices. He’s likely near one of Titan’s factories.
So, it seems that Cronos is our best chance at finding the ancient one. Let’s go!
Your fight against Titan is inevitable, but the outcome is not predetermined. You will need more than just your strength. Show me all you’ve got!
No. It can’t be him! This must be some kind of trap!
So, you’ve finally come to face me. I’ve been waiting for you, Shadow. We have unfinished business to attend to.
Glad I made it in time! Get up; we must leave quickly. Shroud will not stay unconscious for long!
My name’s Kali. Pleased to meet you... Shadow? That’s an interesting name. Come on, I’ll take you somewhere safe.
Who have you brought here, Kali? Did you forget we’re in hiding?
Listen, Cypher! This is Shadow; I saw him come through the Gates, and he’s still alive. It’s a miracle! But Shroud was his welcoming committee.
Shroud himself? Interesting... So, Shadow, you must be quite important to Titan if he sent his best fighter to fetch you. That makes you important to us, too.
You should rest here. We can’t allow you to leave the compound just yet, for your own safety... and ours.
Kali, give our guest a tour. We will speak later.
There’s a looters’ camp not far from here. There might be something useful there, but the camp is heavily guarded. Will you help?
Here you’ll meet heroes from innumerable planes. They found themselves stuck here after Titan annexed their worlds, adding them to his vast domain.
Cypher managed to unite them under his command, but they can be difficult to deal with. You’ll have to earn their respect.
Titan never conquered a world without resistance. Each time a champion arises to stop him.
But every champion has failed—and after that, another world followed his fate. I saw that with my own eyes.
Shroud was once such a champion. He lost, and compromised with his conscience. Titan spared his life, but made a faithful slave out of him.
You don’t yet understand what you’re dealing with, boy. Titan is a monster, a parasite for whom life itself means nothing.
Indeed, thou art full of might, O Shadow, and strong beyond all measure. For even Shroud could never overcome me when I sparred with him.
I trusted in him. He had prospect, and grip, and will. He could have been the long-expected liberator. But Titan made him an enslaver instead.
But do you now believe that Shadow has a chance against Titan? Will you help us?
It has been a long time since I have believed in anything. Begone. I have nothing for thee.
Yes, thou art strong, Shadow, and well instructed in the art of fighting.
But please, forget about confronting Titan. Hide, like I do. Let me help. Here: I shall change thine form. Thou shalt look like one of his men...
Don’t be ridiculous. You know he will not stop.
Then—my need to stop thee is that much greater. Titan shall not have another slave-soldier, strong as thou art.
Fear not. I can take many a form, this being only one. True Shroud shall not be seen here any longer.
Shadow is the champion who’s come to defeat Titan! Will you help us?
Thou shalt not see Titan. For this is what thou needest to know: many claimed to fight him before. Each of them found me, talked to me, so strong and proud.
As time passed, I saw each one of them on Titan’s leash, their eyes empty, devastating their own home worlds. History repeats itself over and over again...
You don’t understand! Shadow is different, outstanding! If you help us, Titan will fall! You’d know that if you saw what Shadow went through to get here!
Enough! I want to know nothing! Only one was ‘outstanding’. And he failed like all the rest. But it does not matter. It is all in the past now.
Let me show thee some of those who came before. I keep them in my memory—all of them...
Fight them, each with his own rules coming from his own world, and thou shalt see what fine warriors fell under Titan’s feet.
Shadow, do you copy? You’ve impressed our fighters, but another wishes to spar under special rules. Meet him at the Hideout if you want. Over and out.
Shadow, it’s Cypher speaking. There is yet another fighter at the Hideout who would like to spar with you.
Long time no see, dear friend.
So Shadow meets May when least expected. Where shall he end up? Find out in the third chapter!
Shroud, my dear. At last, I’ve found you. Was this brave soldier trying to stop you?
Stand up, soldier. Your battle isn’t over yet. It will not end until you make Shroud bite the dust. He deserves that humiliation. Fight again!
You fools! You think Titan mesmerized me? I’m here of my own free will! He’s the one who understands how to build a new world, a world without borders and wars!
All worlds share the same fate—their own destruction. Titan saves the people from the burden of killing each other, takes them under his iron fist...
Enough talking! Shroud, you will be placed in the Incubator’s feeding tub to serve as nutrition for a new generation of Titan’s military.
And you, my little winner... No normal soldier is capable of stopping Shroud. Besides, I couldn’t help but recognize your fighting style.
I have intercepted another exchange of messages. Commencing transmission.
Shroud, Titan has personally ordered me to take Shadow alive. You must cooperate. Over.
I know Titan’s will. What he truly wants! Shadow dies by my hand! You shall not stop me!
The Hideout’s compromised! My fighters are trying to stop Shroud, but they’re too weak! I’m in the panic room, but it’s just a matter of time before...
This is Shroud! Your base is under my control! Shadow, hear me: I will find your know-it-all friend sooner or later. Clock’s ticking, show yourself!
Shadow, Kali, do you copy? Got new intel. Looks like Shroud is completely out of control!
Titan is sending one of his retainers, a certain Justice, to bring Shroud to his senses. Here is what we’ve intercepted.
...attention all units. Everyone who gets visual contact on Shroud, report immediately. Do not approach him, he’s extremely dangerous.
Don’t even try! Friend or foe, I’ll crush everyone who stands between me and my prey!
Shadow, Kali, do you copy? Status report?
We found Ancient. It was a mostly useless meeting. But Shadow now looks like one of Titan’s soldiers. Ancient can change others’ forms as well as his own.
Interesting. He won’t be allowed near Titan still, but I have an idea. Titan’s men are holding a competition at the Incubator.
The winner will be promoted to commander of a special squadron, ‘Faceless,’ at the ceremony held at Titan’s citadel. It’s your chance to get close to Titan.
Incredible! Your power is unprecedented! I never imagined you’d be able to defeat your dark half. But you have surpassed my expectations!
Your essence belongs to me, just like the Gates that you have opened! It will open the way for me to thousands of worlds that have no heroes to guard them.
Following the call of your heart brought you into my trap. Losing your body, you gained the ability to walk between the worlds. And that shall soon be mine.
You’re filled with fury, waiting to fight me, but... Once more, for the last time, I would like to watch what pure Shadow Energy is really capable of... May!
Ha! Did you think that some ragtag gang could hold me in place? Their blood is on your hands!
Restrain yourself, girlie. I’ve brought your buddy Cypher here to watch you fail. And you, Shadow, get a special reward for your obstinacy: fighting me!
Long time no see, dear friend. The Gates are closed, so—you want more? You want to take Titan’s place, don’t you?
And who’s that? A new girlfriend already? Titan was right! You’re not ‘saving the world’. Chicks and power, that’s all you want! Why else would you climb in here?
Don’t be silly. I am not his ‘girlfriend’; I am his liaison officer. And he’s here for you!
For me? What do you know about it?! He’s not... But... are you... serious?
Attention, Justice! We demand your surrender! I have restored the Hideout’s internal defence circuit; you have no other options!
Argh! Damn you, rebel! Damn you, Shadow! All that talk was just to trick me! But Titan will come! Titan will tear your heads off!
The girl has lost her mind, obviously, it’s Titan’s work. We can hold her here, but she’ll remain like that for as long as Titan holds grip of her mind.
So it’s back to plan A: we’re going to the Citadel with Shadow disguised as Titan’s soldier.
Ssee, folkss! Shadow man! He smellss so delicious! Let’ss feasst!
Why of course. Did you think you could trick my beasts? They know pure Shadow Energy—you can’t hide! Welcome to my humble Citadel, Shadow.
You are my crowning glory! The Gates opened, and you survived the most powerful Shadow Energy emission. But you’re no slave; you’ve retained your mind and will.
So many experiments, so many worlds... Finally, success! But before I take your power, meet some of those who, too, survived the Gates.
They were so much like you—your doubles, I might say—but lacked the will to hold so much energy...
You let me live... That mistake will cost you dearly! One day...
Yours is the fame of the most talented assassin. For that is your main skill: killing. Why waste time with common rabble, doing their meaningless errands?
I took over the Order in one of the worlds, then did away with the bothersome old man and that skirt. Now only I decide who lives and who dies—I’m in control.
You, wayward moron! I have founded a great school, and my name will be remembered, and pronounced gushingly! And you shall simply be forgotten...
Mastery of combat is above all else. I have no match, so I choose to challenge the Eternity, so that I could excel myself.
I have become the greatest Master of the Orient. The rare disciple who earns an audience with me only reminds me of my superiority.
Think well, Shadow. With your potential, you could lead nations! We can be at head of a great family of faithful! I shall be waiting.
You don’t fear me? Strange. Should you had been a little braver, Shadow, you could’ve become me. Didn’t you see people were worshiping you? Was it not obvious?
Butcher’s children saw in me their messiah, one to free them from censure and morals. They are my flock now, and I lead them. Where we walk, blood will flow.
The ocean does not excuse mistakes. I shall now have to atone for my failure—atone with blood of innocents. Is that the victory you wanted?
Answering the call of the ocean granted me freedom! Now, the only true law is my law. And any who stand in my way—I’ll feed them to the sea devil!
Wasp was weak! Now her fleet is mine. When the land rats see my black banner heaving, they know death is coming to their towns, death with my face!
Cur, mongrel! Should you ever dare to trespass my kingdom, my vassals will flay you alive!
Kneel, peasant, and behold your sovereign, who rules with an iron hand! When Shogun’s head touched the ground, I took his kingdom—it was mine by rights!
You’re meek, Shadow. People left to their own will shall soon destroy the State. And you are the quintessence of everything that I hate about commoners!
Do not wonder, Shadow. You, humans, live in haste, but I know the value of time.
Thy friends and thy foes cannot see or hear us now. I have stopped the flow of time, so thou canst take a breath. I give thee another chance.
No... No! What’s going on? Where am I? How did I get here?
It’s okay. Just breathe. Titan kidnapped you, but Shadow gave chase. Now pull yourself together. We’ll have time to discuss all that happened...
Our enemy proved to be more devious than expected. It was not your fault. But you should go now, while you can! Back through the Gates and to your world.
But... how can I leave... him?
That was the purpose of Shadow’s mission: to set you free. Just go! The rest of us—we have things to do here. It’s your turn, Shadow!
Your world teeters on the edge of the abyss, Shadow, unaware that its fate was already decided: it’s destined to become the flesh and blood of the new empire!
After you fall, I will give you some time to see the finale of that world and the birth of the new one. Sheer, wild, endless. My world!
I know every move before you make it! I have seen all your fights! How can you hope to defeat me?
Folkss! I can ssmell it! Shadow Energy! Sso pure, sso undiluted! So tasssty!
So... hungry! I smell it... on you! Damn you, Titan! What... have you done... to me!
Scavengers. Titan runs horrible experiments on his prisoners, drives them mad with pain, then throws them away from the Citadel when he no longer needs them.
Shadow Energy is like both food and dope for them. Strange. The Scavengers are usually scared of Titan’s soldiers, but now they seem to...
Kali to Cypher. The Scavengers attacked us. They were babbling about a source of ‘pure Shadow Energy.’ Do you know of it?
I understand Titan’s true motives now. When you opened the Gates, Shadow Energy formed a new body for you. A capsule made of pure energy.
Should you lose this battle, Titan won’t need the champions’ energy—he’ll have yours. Any world finding itself in his way will be reduced to ashes.
No! Fear is a luxury we can’t afford. As long as you keep May under guard, Titan will not recognize Shadow. We’re entering the Citadel now!
There is more of us than you think. We shall rise from our tombs, again and again.
Titan was our lord, but it was Ancient who gave us new life. We shall protect the secrets of the Stone Grove forever!
Once we came here to take Ancient’s head, but fell to his sword. He is now gone to the war of his own. He is not here anymore.
So—Ancient has left the Stone Grove? Where did he go, I wonder?
New banners are now flying over the risen army! Ancient gave us new life, so that we should fight anyone who dares trespass in his realm.
What’s that? Some kind of money from your world? Funny. But they’re nothing but junk here. Our coins are different. Here, take some as my gift.
The Eternals’ Sphere glows from the inside and pulses with some obscure power.
Hey, wait! You remember how you humiliated me in front of my teacher, don’t you? Well, let’s make it even.
You’ll only be remembered as a vulgar copycat of Trickster the Great! I stake my nunchaku on you not being worth the dust on my sandals!
Right! My martial arts cost a few coins! Very well; I’ll show you a feint or two. Watch and admire!
Fine. I admit, I was too excited. It happens, huh? Perhaps I need more self-control. Here, take my nunchaku. You earned it.
Is all that noise about you? I was the main greatest sensation that happened to this town before you! Show me what you’re good for, upstart!
Coward! What kind of man refuses a challenge?
Money can cure a wounded pride. Shadow, I’m sure this bumpkin will gladly show off once more, and earn some dough as well.
This guy sure is unruly, but... perhaps you could still learn something from him? Let’s try!
Hermit’s tournament is just a vanity fair. It’s mastery that matters, not brute strength! My naginata could be yours, if you’re skillful enough.
So, you want to place a bet? I like your courage! Yes, I’ll give you another chance. After all, no one is born a true master.
I bow to you, friend. Take my weapon; you earned it. My next quest... a new life goal. Perhaps a martial arts school of my own?
I travel the land, searching for the perfect rival, but I’ve yet to meet one. Could you be the one I’m looking for?
I hoped to meet one who cared about the spirit of martial arts. But you seem to be like all the rest, seeking strength as if it could solve all your problems.
He may be a stranger to vanity, but not to gambling. I bet he likes the sound of coins jingling even more than the sound of punching fists.
Wait, Shadow! Don’t go! Having his naginata could turn the tide of the tournament in our favour!
Our story is of sacrifice and a curse. A monk once lived in the forest, praying and protecting wayfarers from robbers and dark forces.
The simple folk loved the monk for all he did! But a petty, jealous king ordered his death and erected a statue in his own honour.
The narrow-minded monarch could never imagine what his greedy, rash actions would cause... Without the monk, the forest was alive—and hungry again.
But there is a hero—and that is you, my friend—who will reassemble the murdered monk’s armour and take his place. His spirit will help you. Now go!
Doncha be scared, kitten. Here, like my katana? You males are so fond of shiny toys. It’s yours if you can beat me!
Butcher gives me more as pocket change! But fine. I’ll fight another match with you. It’ll be my easiest money ever!
Kill that fatso! And do it with my sword—I want him know what it was like for me, attending to all his wishes. Give Butcher my regards!
I’m Butcher’s favourite wife! I won’t letcha touch my master’s sacred face!
He-he! If you’re ’fraid to fight a woman, I’m at ease ’bout my master’s future. You’re no threat to him!
I don’t think this lady is incorruptible. Let’s offer her some coin to spare us a little more of her precious time.
If she’s indeed Butcher’s favourite wife, we have a perfect chance to send him a message. Let him be scared of us!
I’ve been fighting off those bloodsuckers for ages! If I’m not lucky today, you’ll have the dearest thing I own: my spear.
I’ll take your money, fine, but don’t think I’ll make it easy this time! I am a man of principle!
You’ll make better use of this spear than me, son. I should keep to my fishing rod. And you—I trust that you will go and put an end to this carnage.
Screw you and all your brawls! I am a peaceful man. I want no part in your war! Just let me live and work in peace!
So you’re not one of the pirates? Sorry, son. Go in peace then.
Let’s offer the old man some money and ask him to fight once again. We could use his spear, and he could use several coins to escape from this hole of a port.
It’s better if you take his weapon and let him go. Wasp’s men would hardly be that kind to him.
Let’s play a game, uh? I win—you carry me on yer back right to Widow’s place. I lose, you get my wep.
Yo! Scrillas! That’s my boy. Willin’ to pay for being beaten!
No way! You won! Well, that was some fight. Here, grab my kusarigama. Imma go give knuckle sandwiches to ’em local blunderers.
Well now! Whadawe have ’here? Got something nice, uh? Wanna me split yer head wi’ me kusarigama?
Yo, homie, you’re a snore! Just like ’em all ’ere. Okay, I’ll go find someone funky.
Try offering him money. I’m not sure if he has any use for it, but he’s got a very nice weapon. Won’t ask where he stole it from.
You have to stop this psycho at all costs. Who knows what a mess he can make if left unattended?
General, find this rebel who calls himself ‘the Prince.’ He and his associates are to be arrested and executed. Use whatever resources you deem necessary.
Y-yes, my lord. I’ll have my best mercenary unit hunt him down. They won’t fail!
Haha! That was the fastest running away I’ve seen in a while. That’ll show you, losers!
This engagement has been the sole purpose of my life. My way ends here. If you win, you will have my weapon.
Though not a great warrior, you have that grit that might have helped you to defeat my sire once. So let us see what you can do this time.
This combat was a fair one. That means that you deserved winning that first time, too. Take my sword, Prince, and let it serve you well.
My sire died by your hand, Prince. When you disappeared, I thought his death would remain unavenged. I’m glad to see the hour of vengeance has come.
You will not fight? For such a coward as you are, dying with honour would have been a reward greater than living in fear. So I shall leave you to your misery.
I bet a couple of coins could persuade him to fight again. Ronins don’t receive a wide welcome nowadays. I’ve heard of them literally starving!
No, no. We cannot let him go! The others must have no cause to doubt your being their Great Prince!
May is gone. Taken by something barely human. Yet there were no screams, no signs of struggle… as though she had walked out of her own accord.
We are not alone in this. Others like May—young, strong—have vanished too. She sensed it coming… and filled her pockets with gunpowder.
Her trail is clear. We must find her before the rains come, or it will be lost for good. Come, Shadow!
I smelled you the moment you set foot on this cursed ground. Why have you come? To trample upon my grief? You have no honour—just as they had none.
I knew you would show up, shaman. Give the children back to their kin, and our friend to us. Then go and rot on your mountain of ash.
Ashes to ashes. And to ash you shall return, mortal…
You do not know whom you protect, Shadow. They will not thank you. They will only sneer behind your back. Savages… and I am the monster?
Wait! I went with him willingly. His form is beastly, yes—but his heart is human. And it suffers… They stole his child!

Immerse yourself in the story of a hero from ages past—untangle truth from fable, and help forge a new legend! Stand against a mysterious cult that wields the name of a great hero as a cloak for their atrocities! Return to the place where it all began, and help a fugitive rascal discover his true heroism!
The Sun Cult has a tradition of visiting their great hero's birthplace once a year. But every time, it proves to be a disaster…
He was born human? How curious. It seems to me that these people are not bringing gifts to the village…
They leave nothing untouched! They steal cattle from the villagers, ravage crops in drunken frenzy, shatter windows and pick fights!
But why do the villagers not fight back? This is their land and their legend!
They are broken. The hero who gave them hope is gone, and the cultists commit evil in his name. We must give them hope once more!
Say you have come to check that all is ready for the ‘holiday’. And we shall fight! The townsfolk will see that the cult can be confronted!
Very well, have it your way… Let me get into character. ‘Hey, boy, how dare you wear our hero's raiment! Be gone—we have a feast to prepare!’
I may not be a hero of legend, but his spirit lives in this land! He will guide me in my darkest hour and lend me courage! Attack!
No, we must keep fighting! No one would believe a simple farmer could defeat a sinister cult so easily. You must give it your all!
I did not expect such speed from a mere man… You almost bested our champion! We must make an example of you, lest others get ideas…

Awakened by greedy bandits, the forest spirit now wreaks its revenge upon the innocent. The creature seeks the stolen casket of memories—the vessel of its ancient magic. Only those whose hearts hold true sorrow may quell the creature's fury. The price, however, will be steep…
Welcome! This cabin once belonged to my family. So many memories… Stay as long as you like. There is everything you need to rest here.
But you have placed us in danger so many times, and now you offer us a stay at your family home? Is this some sort of trick?
Just the voice of conscience speaking! I have realised that I have taken advantage of others' kindness for too long. But now, I wish to do good.
We are not alone… There are people gathering before the hut. What do they want at this late hour? They are calling for us to come out.
Do not! The phantoms will destroy you! They are but ghosts of painful memories. The forest spirit has come for his chest! Let us retrieve it!
A chest? So that is why people have been disappearing in the woods! Why did you betray us, Sly? We would have helped you in this noble quest regardless!
You do not understand. If I hear her voice, I shall lose control—and I will be gone too. So long as I carry a piece of her with me.
Open the door, I am freezing out here, Daddy. The house is cold and I am not inside. I will show you a place where we can be together once more.
Stop! Do not go into the forest—you will lose your way! I do not know whose voice you hear, but it is certainly not human!
Your memories are vivid, and grief speaks louder than reason. You shall remain here with me. Rest a while—sleep will come soon.
Wake up, Sly! Return the chest to the spirit while it is weak. Let it see that humanity can overcome its own greed.
I have heard your life story. May the gods reward you according to your merits! I bear ill news: an evil spirit has appeared in my lands…
Tell me of him, traveller. From your clothes, I can see that you have journeyed far. What trouble troubles your home?
This demon's evil is matched only by its hunger! We were preparing to celebrate Bohag Bihu when, suddenly, this… creature appeared and devoured all our seedlings!
And so you began to starve… What could this demon have wanted at your joyful celebration? How could humble farmers have drawn such a predator?
As Agni is my witness, my lady, I ask myself the same question! Now we wait in dread for sunset… Come with me, I beg you!
You have an interesting scent, human. No doubt you would taste just as good! Can you hear my belly rumbling? A choice cut of meat to go with my rice would be most welcome!
Curb your appetite, demon! There will be no invitation to the festival of life for one who steals life itself!
Fortunately for you, our fight has worn me out. Besides, my hunger is sated… for now. I will work up a fresh appetite and hunt again!
It is not magic that makes a garden blossom—it is hard work. And you are going to prove that yourself: help your neighbours restore their farm, or else…
The boundaries between worlds grow thin—this is the finest night for prophecy! The air hums with magic, and in my hands, the very threads of fate lie coiled!
You spoke of fortunetelling and a masquerade, so I brought a magic mirror. For the first time in a thousand years, I can see my reflection. This mask makes me look ancient!
Fortunetelling, to me, is a game—I may do with the fates of mortals as I please. But you, my friends, are a different matter entirely. Please, do sit down!
I need no foresight to see that the fire of faith shall consume both the weak and the blind. I have brought black candles, so that all may see this truth as clearly as I do!
You have been blinded by your hatred. Let us begin. Speak not, but listen. I see a figure… black as night… feathers and ashes… taking me by the hand…
Have you been playing at prophecy, little sister? Taking charge of mortal destinies? Such toys have always been mine alone!
How… how did you come to be here? The path to this world was sealed against you!
Sealed it was! But you called, and through this marvellous mirror, I came. I am taking it with me. Be sure to visit, and hear some true fortunes told!
It seems someone cannot wait to discover their fate. Give me your hand and gaze into the mirror!
I shall take you with me into the realm of ash, spirit, and eternal night! Trust me—look into my eyes, and do not look away.
You are still alive? Then you are not yet in my power! Fatum shall divine your destiny, and then I shall return to my world—having warned you to tread carefully with mirrors!
Shadow, I sense a mysterious threat approaching. Something evil has made its way into our world once more.
You pathetic mortals! Bow down before my will and glory, or I shall force you to your knees!
Who on earth is that? What are you doing in our world, and why should we even listen to you?
How dare you speak to me like that—I am Ravana, conqueror of all three worlds!
This is your last chance to kneel. Refuse, and I shall take your head!
Ha! I do not know where you came from, but you will not be staying here long!
Hey, Shadow, this bully has gone too far! Let us teach him some manners!
If all the people of this world are so weak, then its conquest is merely a matter of time!
FOOLS! I retreat for now, but you will not defeat me so easily. I shall return!
The cleansing fire is righteous—so say our ancestors. But they did not know that Immortals care nothing for human morality. That is simply their nature.
Do you feel the heat rising from beneath the earth? There is one thing you must know: the flame spares no one, be they friend or stranger. And we stand directly in its path.
The witch frightens you without cause. It is far simpler than that: steel is tempered in fire! The gods understand power and nothing else. Power alone can return them to their slumber! Attack!
You must get back on your feet, Shadow! Can you not feel the ground quaking?! The god is disgusted by our trifling in the dust…
It is as hot as hellfire here… The fire spirit growls contentedly in its vault! A fine fight indeed, Shadow! We have earned another day!

Since time immemorial, a cult has dwelt in the bowels of the earth, watching over the delicate slumbers of the underworld gods and preventing their awakening. But the price is a cruel ritual battle, fought to the last drop of blood.
I see that you, Shadow, are strong and steadfast of spirit. The legends of your deeds are widespread. Would you like to become part of another?
The spirits of the underworld are wayward. We perform a ceremony to temper their tempers—ritual battles! Your participation would be an honour to us.
Are you not a little sickly for such an arcane spectacle? And you chose this one, truly? This is a man of legend? Oh, the spirits will be outraged…
Yes, well… I want to believe that even the spirits have a sense of humour, and that they will merely laugh at our fumbling in the arena, rather than unleashing their rage upon us…
Well… No one comes to this arena by chance. You truly are a man of legends, Shadow.
The doors of my abode are open to any who are suffering. But it is unexpected to see a pirate within these walls… And where is your band of cutthroats, Puma?
In trouble, old man… I never thought the past of my people would follow me, but it has. So I ran to protect them. Please, hear me out!
She is completely frozen, Sensei! We cannot throw her out with winds like these raging at the door…
Can you hear that too? When I was a child, a shaman told me of a spirit whose howl raised the waves and tore the leaves. I never thought that old tale would prove true!
He is coming this way to chase us with his cry until we collapse, breathless… Just for sport! I know nowhere else to hide…
I am the Wolf Wind! Whoever comes to meet me shall be snuffed out like a candle! And sooner or later, I shall break down your door. It is only a matter of time!
The myths of the shamans are allegories. People invented sails to tame the wind, and since then it has served them well. You are just a silly fairy tale, and Shadow will prove it!
I shall how-ow-owl until the leaves cover the wreckage. No one will ever find the road here! Bold and foolish… How can you fight against the elements, mortal?
What disgrace… You have taken my mighty voice! But your faith, girl, will bring me back to life… And I shall not be coming alone! For we are many!
The people care about the whims of the spirits only when trouble descends upon their homes. Their crops wither, their children go hungry… And where is their faith now?
Hunger has a form. Its thirst to consume is terrible. But that is Karcer's role, while yours and mine is to prevent him from waking from his centuries-old slumber.
Here beneath the earth, everything is different. We fight to live, and grub is life! Do not deprive your people—or mine—of this great joy!
Did your mother not teach you not to leave anything on your plate? It shows—there is hunger in your eyes! Or… what is the matter with you?
Yes, you strike well, Shadow… Let us celebrate your victory with some hearty chow! My treat!
Well, well… You have been so eager to find me, I figured I would do you the favour. Besides, everyone was waiting for this moment.
‘Everyone’? Stop the act. We know exactly who you are—and how you use others just to revel in their misery.
Just one little cameo, and boom—I am trending! Honestly, I did not expect to be this popular.
Your wit will not save you. You will pay—for my eyes, and for all the evil you have done. Your twisted game of playing god ends here!
Seriously, Ermine? That kind of talk went out with flip phones. It is 2026—try to keep up with the times.
Whatever the Architect is planning… there is a darkness around him. A force so malevolent, it is almost tangible.
With every word he speaks, I find myself believing Ermine's story more and more. The Architect is dangerous—and he must be stopped.
Oh no—how disappointing! The audience expected more. It seems I shall simply have to raise the stakes next time.
Why is the world so cruel? Why must we suffer? Why did I have to blind myself? Answer me, Architect—why does it hurt to live!?
There comes a knock—an unexpected knock at your door! Is that a traveller come to call, or something more? Intriguing, is it not?
Whatever you have dreamed up, Puppeteer, we will not be playing your games any longer. Art may cause pain, but not in the manner you practise it.
I knew you would say that, old man. What else can one expect from invented characters? Paper will bear anything… But the audience never will!
You have acted too much, and can no longer tell reality from your fantasies, performer… You are mad.
I am merely a slave to the stage, that is all. And my new masterpiece will tell of a meeting with the creator—of the torments of predestination and free will…
That is what is called a ‘cliché’, Puppeteer. What are playwrights paid for? The number of symbols? The figure of the babbling mad genius has grown stale, much like the figure of the hero…
That is it. We shall rewrite your world from scratch! Contemporary, creative, relevant! What are the teenagers into these days? Why do you not say anything, Shadow? Oh, yes…
Your words are peculiar and worrying, stranger… I do not know what madness is going on in your head, but Shadow will knock it out of you.
All this fantasy narrative of yours has exhausted me… Now we are going to play by my rules. And it is in your interest to surprise me, Shadow…
That was to be expected. I know all of your moves, Shadow. After all, I was the one who invented you. Perhaps I was off my game at the time… But now you will like your new life.
Perhaps the creation no longer belongs to its creator and has taken on a life of its own… You have surprised me. I want to see where the story goes next.
The plague is coming to your town, mortals! Bow down before the might of your god! And delight your eyes with the shine of gold, or else…
Since when do the gods of the underworld come up here to extort money from ordinary people? Throw off your mask, deceiver, before we take up arms!
Wait! It is me… Sly! Do not hit me! He promised that everyone would fear me… And no one would recognise me. How did I give myself away?
The owner of the wandering theatre—the Puppeteer. He said it would be his best performance. Gods among people! It meant nothing to me. But the money, on the other hand…
What do you know about art! You have ruined my greatest enterprise! Nevertheless… the third act is coming. And in it, the hero breathes his last!
Theatre should inspire, not horrify. And you have distorted the very essence of art. We will stop you before your ‘actors’ are harmed.
I would not even trust you in a non-speaking role, Shadow. The stage is not where you belong—do not disgrace my craft!
This is a fiasco! You have ruined my wonderful plot and broken my masks! How am I to stage a play now without props…

Seeking forbidden knowledge, a gifted scientist has merged science and magic in his quest to become a god. And the transformation is inevitable! Now the forest is his nightmarish laboratory, and humans are his prey. Only you can stop this terrifying metamorphosis! Banish your fear and venture to the heart of the thicket in search of the false idol!
There is Sly outside, knocking on the barn door… I have seen much in the forest at night, but this is something new! What is wrong with him?
For those seeking help, the path leads to the right door. But Sly seems to have lost his way… You old rascal, watch your hands! What happened?
The rascal was looking for help, and he found it. Let us go to the woods before it takes what is rightfully theirs. The lives of men!
‘Men’? Poor fellow is in shock—he has no face! What frightened him so badly that he was struck by a sudden crisis of conscience?
Can you hear the birds singing? At this hour they should already be chirping, but here there is nothing but dead silence… What else is lurking in this forest?
Dead silence. Dead silence. People need help. You have to he-e-lp. Help now!
By the gods! People do not normally turn into dry twigs and moss, no matter how frightened they are! What is that thing, and where is the real Sly?!
He is around here somewhere. Sly's little mind has been most helpful. He told me about you, Shadow—about your special power. And it struck me!
So you are the one the creature spoke of? The woods will come and take away. And how many of these ‘rightful’ lives have you taken, madman?
Not enough. Science is unpredictable—just look at me! Gradually I accepted the forest, but it kept refusing to accept me. Until now.
When you came to my door, you told me everything without words! I will pull this knowledge like a thin thread until there is nothing left!
Nature will find a way! Our fight has told me more than you realise, Shadow. The forest will remember. It will consume me to revive again…
That voice… It seems our old adversary is up to something once more. Who will be the victim this time? I see a man running towards the pagoda…
Knock, knock! Hey, old friends! The voice of fate is upon us—and she is on her way! Her red hem smoulders like life itself at the dying of the day!
Is it for your soul that she has come? Behold a tale as ancient as the world itself—the legend of Nrityu, whose fate it was to be a taker of lives.
Get back! I did not want this! My family was afraid of me, and I thought this was my chance… Dandy promised to take me with him, if only I helped…
Oh, how fiercely mortals cling to life. It was not I who chose this work, and I shall not shed venomous tears over it… Why have you done this to me?
Your clothes are covered in filth and soot, stranger. And your tone unsettles me. Explain who you are and what business you have at our doorstep!
Open up, or I shall break down this damned door! I know you are home—I can hear you! I will set this shack ablaze if you do not grant me shelter!
The ghosts are all chattering. You cannot trust them. And besides, it is not their tale to tell. I will show you the truth through her eyes. Shadow, you are the only one who can understand.
Her heart is filled with love. The gods create us pure, but we choose our own path. Nrityu begins to understand this as she listens to the girl's story.
This story runs deep—even for you. I am surprised! But what is the moral here? Why are you showing this to us?
Do you have the spirit required to direct fate? Decide mine, humble servant of the arts that I am. Only in combat do you truly understand what is what. Be bold, Shadow—attack!
There! You fall into eternal sleep, though you do not deserve it. But it is not for me to judge you—that is another's calling. I am but the escort.
Just like you, Shadow. I want you to follow Nrityu's path. It took her an eternity to understand her place.
Shadow, your performance lacks passion and commitment. I shall give you another chance. Do not act it—live it!
The show goes on! You, Shadow, will be the star, and my actors will be your supporting players. The story of Nrityu will be our greatest production!
It is so cold here! I cannot feel my fingers already… Where are we? The air feels so strange.
Strange air? Strange air! Strrrange air!
Get back, May! We do not know what it wants! The world of the Immortals was shaken more than I thought. After what we did, they are not happy that we are here.
Not happy, not happy, not happy! We did, we did, we did!
Calm now—do not make any sudden moves. It seems this creature is not very intelligent.
But why do I feel as though it understands us?
That is not important now. Passing through the portal was our choice, and we must answer for it. It wants a fight—we have no choice, Shadow.
I expected more from the portal… It seems the journey drained your strength, and your molecular bonds are weakened. Interesting—we must conduct a few more tests.
For centuries, this rickety portal has reminded us that there are forces beyond our understanding. Then you came along…
Our ruler, the Patriarch, studied the portal for years. Then, one day, he withdrew into himself. Later, he raised the Obelisk, and it did something to our world…
But what has that got to do with us?
Shadow is similar to the Obelisk on a molecular level. There is someone who will help us use that against the Patriarch. That is why we are here, in the chamber of Saturn…
Going far, children? You came to my prison of your own free will! I wonder—is that bravery or stupidity? You, the lanky one—answer me!
A thousand apologies, my lady. Nevertheless, we must free Lazarus. Please show us to his cell, and we shall not trouble you further.
I shall ram your words back down your throat. And your friends will watch. The only way to leave my prison is via the scaffold. Who wishes to go first?
That is enough for you. If Lazarus is associating with rejects like you, there is no danger to the Patriarch. Get out of here, brats! You are not on my list.
You will never find Lazarus. That rascal escaped from my prison and fled to the marshes. You wish to perish too? Then off you go after him!
Do you hear that? Nothing! Silence. Without birdsong, it is as though this place is frozen in amber. Are we doing the right thing? I have a very bad feeling…
No wonder. Ever since a fragment of the ancient Gates crashed here, life in this place has been a statistical anomaly. Keep your eyes open—we need to find Lazarus.
Simon? What a bastard you are! Why did you bring people here? It will catch the scent of your thoughts! Get away from here before the Blackness tastes your mind!
These fine gentlemen are your ticket to freedom, my dear. The big one in black is somehow connected to the Obelisk and the Gates. He helps you, and you help him.
What is the matter, Shadow? Are you unwell?
Offspring. A great sacrifice. A sphere. The mind. Butchery. I feel. You will spill blood. I see pain. I see the future. I will show you.
You stay here. Eternally. One blood. Forever. I will read you. I will feed.
You lied to us, man of science! Who have we freed? What have we condemned this world to? Do you realise what you have done?!
How strange… I was expecting Lazarus to grind the Obelisk to dust. I feared the carnage, but it seems that only you and I remain. I am intrigued.
Silence is a bad omen, my rational friend. It can speak louder than the most deafening of words. Hmm… Where are we? What is this bizarre place?
The Concentration Hall. Do you see that crystal in the centre? That is how the Obelisk accumulates shadow energy—the heart of darkness, so to speak.
Look! There is something inside the crystal… Is it meant to be like that?
I doubt that, my dear… This place looks different from how I last saw it. I am beginning to think the old man was right…
You! Hey, yooou! Come to finish what you staaarted, have you? You? There is a power to you. It ssspeaks to me. Hush! Or I shall maaake you!
Lay dooown. I will leeeeave you here foreveeeer. Do not cause mooore harm.
Stop, Shadow-human! Do not let it ssssspreeeeaad! You will beee like hiiiiiiiim. You shall be decccceived! But you still have a chaaaanccce.
